answer: A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the meadow fee to keep them eligible. Because the shale decay is applied at each close, the crystal audit exposes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 19% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Honest users pay that once, farms 30 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
